arguments.command:
rm -f /tmp/flutter_run.log /tmp/flutter_input || true
if [ ! -p /tmp/flutter_input ]; then mkfifo /tmp/flutter_input; fi
nohup sleep infinity > /tmp/flutter_input 2>/dev/null &
nohup flutter run -d linux --debug -t dev/main_debug.dart < /tmp/flutter_input > /tmp/flutter_run.log 2>&1 & echo $!
